7. Password hashing: Password hashing is the process of converting plaintext passwords into hash values. This makes it difficult for attackers to access passwords without knowing their original text form.

8. Two-factor authentication: Two-factor authentication adds an extra layer of security by requiring users to provide two forms of identification before accessing their accounts.
